source.title: Fantasy Football Draft Targets and Fades: Scott Pianowski reveals his top picks and players to avoid at each position
source.author: Scott Pianowski

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski targets Herbert after offseason fixes in Los Angeles.
takeaways.rationale: He expects new offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel to repair what failed in 2025.
risks: The case depends on a successful coordinator transition

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski targets Prescott in another likely high-volume Dallas offense.
takeaways.rationale: A fun offense, weak defense, and two star receivers create strong passing conditions.
risks: The recommendation assumes Dallas again plays in frequent shootouts

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski considers Goff's late ADP a gift.
takeaways.rationale: Goff has averaged strong touchdown and yardage totals across four years and draws an easy, indoor-heavy schedule.
risks: His fantasy ceiling relies heavily on passing efficiency rather than rushing

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski views Robinson as a repeat league-winner worthy of an early pick.
takeaways.rationale: Robinson has an elite all-purpose profile and Atlanta reinforced its commitment with a record contract.
risks: His acquisition cost is among the highest in drafts

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski gives Taylor a green light if Daniel Jones is healthy.
takeaways.rationale: Taylor was producing at an elite level before Jones' injury changed Indianapolis' offense.
risks: The recommendation is conditional on Daniel Jones being cleared

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski sees Brown as a dependable Round 2 target.
takeaways.rationale: Brown has delivered for two seasons and stays on the field across packages.
risks: A second-round price leaves less room for role or efficiency regression

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski calls Hubbard a boring but useful value.
takeaways.rationale: His touch volume and productive 2024 return support the discounted veteran case.
risks: The ceiling may be less exciting than other backs near his cost

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski sees Corum as immediately flex-worthy with major contingency upside.
takeaways.rationale: Corum already has a role and would gain a much larger ceiling if the starter ahead of him is injured.
risks: His best outcome may require an injury ahead of him

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski recommends pouncing if Jefferson reaches Round 2.
takeaways.rationale: He expects Kyler Murray and Kevin O'Connell to restore Minnesota's offense.
risks: The rebound depends on a new quarterback fit

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski treats McConkey's 2025 as an excused absence and targets the rebound.
takeaways.rationale: Mike McDaniel's arrival should improve McConkey's offensive environment.
risks: The case assumes last season was not indicative of his true level

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski targets Egbuka as Tampa Bay's potential target leader.
takeaways.rationale: Mike Evans is gone and Chris Godwin is aging, leaving a clear runway for a larger share.
risks: A toe injury and veteran competition still need monitoring

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski targets Evans for touchdown upside in San Francisco.
takeaways.rationale: Evans remains an elite scoring specialist and Kyle Shanahan can scheme scoring opportunities.
risks: Age and existing injury concerns raise the floor risk

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski calls Coker a screaming late-round value.
takeaways.rationale: Coker improved late in 2025 and Carolina's contract commitment supports a larger role.
risks: He still shares the offense with Tetairoa McMillan

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski targets Warren for a sophomore jump at a favorable price.
takeaways.rationale: He sees upside comparable to Colston Loveland while Warren costs slightly less.
risks: The recommendation depends on a second-year leap

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski considers Pitts reasonably priced after his TE2 breakout.
takeaways.rationale: Atlanta has a narrow target tree and Pitts is being drafted around TE8.
risks: His market price already reflects much of the breakout

takeaways.label: target
takeaways.summary: Pianowski targets Johnson as an overlooked tight end value.
takeaways.rationale: Johnson already delivered a breakout after earning a new contract but remains lightly drafted.
risks: The market may be discounting repeatability concerns

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Maye at cost.
takeaways.rationale: Regression risk, a much harder schedule, and a deep quarterback pool make cheaper options preferable.
risks: Maye could still overcome the schedule through individual growth

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Hurts after a decline in rushing production.
takeaways.rationale: His rushing output fell significantly and Philadelphia's new receivers may need development time.
risks: Hurts' established goal-line role can still preserve a high ceiling

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Mahomes at his market price.
takeaways.rationale: Mahomes is returning from a major knee injury, his rushing may regress, and the offense has underwhelmed for two years.
risks: Elite quarterback talent always leaves rebound potential

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades McCaffrey despite his 2025 volume.
takeaways.rationale: Usage masked an efficiency decline, and age creates added running back risk.
risks: His workload and receiving role still support an elite outcome

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Achane because of Miami's supporting cast.
takeaways.rationale: He questions whether Malik Willis will support Achane's valuable receiving workload.
risks: Achane's exceptional talent can overcome imperfect conditions

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Judkins in Cleveland's projected environment.
takeaways.rationale: Limited receiving impact, negative game scripts, and a mediocre team cap the appeal.
risks: A larger-than-expected rushing workload could offset team weakness

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Irving after his 2025 efficiency collapse.
takeaways.rationale: A shoulder issue plus two talented backs behind him threaten both performance and workload.
risks: A healthy Irving has previously shown high-end efficiency

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Harvey at cost.
takeaways.rationale: His rookie touchdown rate should regress and Denver now looks like a three-back committee.
risks: Sean Payton may still create valuable scoring opportunities

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Nabers at a price that assumes a smooth ACL recovery.
takeaways.rationale: Nabers has limited practice history with Jaxson Dart and carries significant return-from-injury uncertainty.
risks: His elite talent can still command a dominant target share

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades McMillan despite the talent.
takeaways.rationale: Jalen Coker can reduce his market share and Bryce Young may limit Carolina's offensive ceiling.
risks: McMillan's talent could still drive elite volume

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Rice because the floor is too uncertain for his price.
takeaways.rationale: Health and off-field concerns make a second- or third-round selection difficult to justify.
risks: A full active season in Kansas City would restore strong target upside

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Williams as an inconsistent name-brand receiver.
takeaways.rationale: A late-season spike may not repeat with Sam LaPorta healthy.
risks: Williams retains game-breaking efficiency and weekly upside

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Tate for 2026 redraft purposes.
takeaways.rationale: Wan'Dale Robinson already knows Brian Daboll's offense and may earn an earlier role.
risks: Tate remains a strong long-term prospect who could develop quickly

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Fannin in Cleveland's crowded and uncertain passing game.
takeaways.rationale: New impact receivers can reduce his share while the quarterback room remains unsettled.
risks: Fannin's established receiving talent can still win targets

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Kraft because his return timetable is uncertain.
takeaways.rationale: Kraft is working back from an ACL tear, making readiness a major question despite the upside.
risks: If fully healthy, Kraft retains a high fantasy ceiling

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Pianowski fades Goedert after an 11-touchdown season.
takeaways.rationale: Touchdown regression is highly likely and his yards per catch reached a new low.
risks: Philadelphia's offense can still create red-zone opportunities
